description:
Nikli Haor । নিকলী হাওর । Nikli Haor Kishoreganj । Dhaka to Nikliday Tour । Mr Luxsu
#nikli_haor #mrluxsu #kishoreganj 
Nikli Haor is located in Nikli Upazila, Kishoreganj, Bangladesh. It is about 110 km away from country's capital Dhaka.Apart from Nikli Upazila, the perimeter of this haor extends to the adjoining Mithamain, Austagram and Itna Upazilas.It is one of the largest freshwater wetlands in Bangladesh and also a popular tourist destination.
The Itna-Mithamoin-Austagram road is a 29.73 kilometer "all-weather" road in the Kishoreganj Haor region of Bangladesh, connecting the upazilas of Itna, Mithamoin, and Austagram. It was constructed at a cost of Tk 874.08 crore to improve connectivity in the Haor area and attract tourists.
